title: Profit per product
prompt: Show each product's name and its price minus its cost, as profit. Replace the ___.
starterSql:
SELECT name, price ___ cost AS profit
FROM products;

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM order_items; DELETE FROM orders; DELETE FROM products; DELETE FROM customers; INSERT INTO customers VALUES (7, 'Ravi', 'Oslo', 'ravi@mail.test', '2024-05-05'), (8, 'Sara', 'Lima', NULL, '2024-06-06'), (9, 'Tom', 'Oslo', NULL, '2024-07-07'); INSERT INTO products VALUES (7, 'Stool', 'Home', 40.0, 25.0), (8, 'Cup', 'Kitchen', 9.0, 2.0), (9, 'Ink', 'Stationery', 12.5, 6.0); INSERT INTO orders VALUES (11, 7, '2024-02-28', 'shipped'), (12, 8, '2024-03-01', 'pending'), (13, 7, '2024-03-31', 'cancelled'); INSERT INTO order_items VALUES (11, 7, 1, 4.0), (11, 8, 3, NULL), (12, 9, 2, NULL), (13, 8, 1, NULL);

solutions: SELECT name, price - cost AS profit FROM products;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT name, price + cost AS profit FROM products;
SELECT name, cost - price AS profit FROM products;

title: Double the order
prompt: Show each order item's order_id and twice its quantity, as doubled.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM order_items; DELETE FROM orders; DELETE FROM products; DELETE FROM customers; INSERT INTO customers VALUES (7, 'Ravi', 'Oslo', 'ravi@mail.test', '2024-05-05'), (8, 'Sara', 'Lima', NULL, '2024-06-06'), (9, 'Tom', 'Oslo', NULL, '2024-07-07'); INSERT INTO products VALUES (7, 'Stool', 'Home', 40.0, 25.0), (8, 'Cup', 'Kitchen', 9.0, 2.0), (9, 'Ink', 'Stationery', 12.5, 6.0); INSERT INTO orders VALUES (11, 7, '2024-02-28', 'shipped'), (12, 8, '2024-03-01', 'pending'), (13, 7, '2024-03-31', 'cancelled'); INSERT INTO order_items VALUES (11, 7, 1, 4.0), (11, 8, 3, NULL), (12, 9, 2, NULL), (13, 8, 1, NULL);

solutions: SELECT order_id, quantity * 2 AS doubled FROM order_items;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT order_id, quantity + 2 AS doubled FROM order_items;
SELECT order_id, quantity AS doubled FROM order_items;

title: Brackets first
prompt: Show each product's name and the profit from selling two of it, as profit_on_two.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM order_items; DELETE FROM orders; DELETE FROM products; DELETE FROM customers; INSERT INTO customers VALUES (7, 'Ravi', 'Oslo', 'ravi@mail.test', '2024-05-05'), (8, 'Sara', 'Lima', NULL, '2024-06-06'), (9, 'Tom', 'Oslo', NULL, '2024-07-07'); INSERT INTO products VALUES (7, 'Stool', 'Home', 40.0, 25.0), (8, 'Cup', 'Kitchen', 9.0, 2.0), (9, 'Ink', 'Stationery', 12.5, 6.0); INSERT INTO orders VALUES (11, 7, '2024-02-28', 'shipped'), (12, 8, '2024-03-01', 'pending'), (13, 7, '2024-03-31', 'cancelled'); INSERT INTO order_items VALUES (11, 7, 1, 4.0), (11, 8, 3, NULL), (12, 9, 2, NULL), (13, 8, 1, NULL);

solutions: SELECT name, (price - cost) * 2 AS profit_on_two FROM products;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT name, price - cost * 2 AS profit_on_two FROM products;
SELECT name, price - cost AS profit_on_two FROM products;

title: Even numbers
prompt: Show the id and name of employees with an even id.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM employees; DELETE FROM departments; INSERT INTO departments VALUES (5, 'Design'), (6, 'Finance'), (7, 'Ops'); INSERT INTO employees VALUES (11, 'Ivy', 5, NULL, 90000, '2019-02-01', 900, 'ivy@acme.test'), (12, 'Jon', 5, 11, 70000, '2020-06-15', NULL, NULL), (13, 'Kim', 6, 11, 70000, '2023-03-03', 300, 'kim@acme.test'), (14, 'Leo', NULL, 77, 30000, '2024-08-20', NULL, 'leo@acme.test'), (15, 'Mia', 6, 13, 55000, '2022-12-31', 0, 'mia@acme.test');

solutions: SELECT id, name FROM employees WHERE id % 2 = 0;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT id, name FROM employees WHERE id % 2 = 1;
SELECT id, name FROM employees WHERE id / 2 = 0;

title: Adding a missing value
prompt: Show each employee's name and salary plus bonus, as total. Employees with no bonus will show NULL, which is correct for this one.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM employees; DELETE FROM departments; INSERT INTO departments VALUES (5, 'Design'), (6, 'Finance'), (7, 'Ops'); INSERT INTO employees VALUES (11, 'Ivy', 5, NULL, 90000, '2019-02-01', 900, 'ivy@acme.test'), (12, 'Jon', 5, 11, 70000, '2020-06-15', NULL, NULL), (13, 'Kim', 6, 11, 70000, '2023-03-03', 300, 'kim@acme.test'), (14, 'Leo', NULL, 77, 30000, '2024-08-20', NULL, 'leo@acme.test'), (15, 'Mia', 6, 13, 55000, '2022-12-31', 0, 'mia@acme.test');

solutions: SELECT name, salary + bonus AS total FROM employees;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT name, salary AS total FROM employees;
SELECT name, salary + bonus AS total FROM employees WHERE bonus IS NOT NULL;

title: Lost decimals
prompt: This should show each session's id and its length in hours, but it shows 0 for most sessions. Fix it.
starterSql:
SELECT id, minutes / 60 AS hours
FROM sessions;
hints: Dividing two integers drops the decimals.
solutions: SELECT id, minutes / 60.0 AS hours FROM sessions;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT id, minutes * 60.0 AS hours FROM sessions;
SELECT id, minutes AS hours FROM sessions;

title: Profit margin
prompt: Show each product's name and its margin as a percentage of price, as margin_pct. Margin is (price - cost) divided by price, times 100.
hints: Use 100.0, with brackets around the subtraction.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM order_items; DELETE FROM orders; DELETE FROM products; DELETE FROM customers; INSERT INTO customers VALUES (7, 'Ravi', 'Oslo', 'ravi@mail.test', '2024-05-05'), (8, 'Sara', 'Lima', NULL, '2024-06-06'), (9, 'Tom', 'Oslo', NULL, '2024-07-07'); INSERT INTO products VALUES (7, 'Stool', 'Home', 40.0, 25.0), (8, 'Cup', 'Kitchen', 9.0, 2.0), (9, 'Ink', 'Stationery', 12.5, 6.0); INSERT INTO orders VALUES (11, 7, '2024-02-28', 'shipped'), (12, 8, '2024-03-01', 'pending'), (13, 7, '2024-03-31', 'cancelled'); INSERT INTO order_items VALUES (11, 7, 1, 4.0), (11, 8, 3, NULL), (12, 9, 2, NULL), (13, 8, 1, NULL);

solutions: SELECT name, (price - cost) * 100.0 / price AS margin_pct FROM products;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT name, (price - cost) / price AS margin_pct FROM products;
SELECT name, (price - cost) * 100.0 / cost AS margin_pct FROM products;

title: Worth discounting
prompt: With 10% off, a product costs price times 0.9. Show the name and sale_price of products whose sale price is above 20.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM order_items; DELETE FROM orders; DELETE FROM products; DELETE FROM customers; INSERT INTO customers VALUES (7, 'Ravi', 'Oslo', 'ravi@mail.test', '2024-05-05'), (8, 'Sara', 'Lima', NULL, '2024-06-06'), (9, 'Tom', 'Oslo', NULL, '2024-07-07'); INSERT INTO products VALUES (7, 'Stool', 'Home', 40.0, 25.0), (8, 'Cup', 'Kitchen', 9.0, 2.0), (9, 'Ink', 'Stationery', 12.5, 6.0); INSERT INTO orders VALUES (11, 7, '2024-02-28', 'shipped'), (12, 8, '2024-03-01', 'pending'), (13, 7, '2024-03-31', 'cancelled'); INSERT INTO order_items VALUES (11, 7, 1, 4.0), (11, 8, 3, NULL), (12, 9, 2, NULL), (13, 8, 1, NULL); UPDATE products SET price = 22.0 WHERE id = 9;

solutions: SELECT name, price * 0.9 AS sale_price FROM products WHERE price * 0.9 > 20;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT name, price * 0.9 AS sale_price FROM products WHERE price > 20;
SELECT name, price AS sale_price FROM products WHERE price * 0.9 > 20;
